title: Michael’s Birthday
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael celebrates his birthday with office festivities, including a surprise party organized by Dwight, birthday wishes from colleagues, and personal reflections. The episode also features Michael discussing his past, his schemes, and concerns about Kevin's health, culminating in a generally positive celebration.
